title: The Numerical Harmony of Genealogies
english: Because of both sequence and harmony, forty-two lies here within a decade. Therefore also in the genealogy there were successions; for it was necessary for the one born from the virgin to be perfect. For every grasping of pleasure comes by the arrival of pleasure.

Just as Saul [the grouping] is from Abraham to David, which in truth are 'fourteen generations' (Matthew 1:17), but from David to the Babylonian exile there are thirteen successions. And since the number fourteen was necessary because of the mystery, he removed the three generations. And again, from the Babylonian exile to Christ, fourteen generations are not found, but twelve in total. And if you even remove Jesus himself, three generations are lacking from the number of the two weeks; for where he removed from the multitude, there he added names to it. Because of the similarity of the weeks, the omission of the three names occurred.

And in the succession he says Joram, Uzziah. And it seems to have the name Uzziah in similarity to that of Jehoiachin; for some consider it to be an evangelical sin, but the imposition of the sin is rather the skill of the wise man, so that he might save the integrity of the numbers. 'Judge me, O God, and plead my cause from an unrighteous nation' (Psalm 7:1). A holy nation he calls, whereas it says, 'Woe to a sinful nation, a people full of iniquities' (Isaiah 5:21). Since therefore he wishes to be judged by this, for they do not have that which I might charge against him; there are no indictments against them. They say, 'This man is not from God, because he does not keep the Sabbath'. And what is it to keep the Sabbath? Is it not necessary in the Sabbath not to raise the dead? How does it become a matter of bringing the 'blind from birth' into sight?
By Beelzebul, the ruler of demons
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Light and Truth of the Word
english: the power of God. You are therefore the God... [these things are] manifest. But he, being changeable, needed strengthening... and if he speaks these things concerning the Word of God, he announces them thus: since you are king and... we have explained and also the 'I live because of the Father'; since my Father is living, [it is a] pattern: 'therefore I am rational, because my Father is rational, and therefore I am alive, because my Father is alive'. If then I am my strength, 'why have you rejected me?'; state the reason for the rejection; for I am neither an unholy nation nor an unrighteous and deceitful man. Declare then, 'for what purpose have you rejected me?'; ... I will plunder him, so that becoming a curse, he may provide a blessing... how a sinner was judged.

And for what purpose do I go about shamed, to afflict my enemy? The Jews who believed in him, therefore, knew the reason of how... but so that it might be revealed to the others who surround him in affliction. 'Send out your light and your truth.' 'I have come as light into the world' the man Jesus... to him. But light and truth the Word of God is; for he himself says: 'I am the light of the world', 'I have come as light into the world', and 'was the true light'. 'Send out' therefore 'your light and your truth'.

And may your truth become manifest, then also the reason will be known... and that the man who was benefited by me fights against me unjustly... he wages war against me. Light and truth are not two... light is, when shining, it illuminates the soul and... the lie, or when it has dispelled the shadow of the law. He had the light and the truth; for he was a temple—but...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Meaning of Thanksgiving
english: my youth. And this altar, into which someone enters, is an interior one. It is an altar, from which the other of the Seraphim took a coal. And there is an altar in heaven, and the souls of those having been overcome because of the testimony of Jesus (Rev 12:11) are near it. And the word shows that 'those having been overcome because of the testimony of Jesus' are as a priest near the altar. Not everyone is able, but 'the one having been overcome because of the testimony'. Therefore this altar is an interior one.

It is according to the imitation of another altar; for all things have been made according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain (Ex 25:40). A sacrifice of praise and that of righteousness is set forth; for 'sacrifice a sacrifice of praise to God' (Ps 50:14) and 'sacrifice a sacrifice of righteousness' (Ps 51:17). 'I will come' (Ps 51:18) therefore 'to the altar of God', then 'to the God who rejoices my youth' (Ps 51:19); for the one turning away from the shadow of the law and the exterior altar says: 'What multitude of your sacrifices to me? I am full' (Ps 50:6), he enters, 'according to the order of Melchizedek priest' (Ps 110:4) saying: 'I will come to the altar of God, better than the visible things'.

'I will come' therefore [away] from the sensible, from the literal, 'into the altar of God'. The one surpassing the 'oldness of the letter' which had preserved the shadow of the law and the old covenant, knowing these things, says: 'I will praise you, O God, with a harp' (Ps 108:2). Because I will enter into your altar having youth from the 'newness of the spirit' having been brought near, through this I will praise you gratefully with a harp. And the harp I have said many times that it signifies practical virtue or the body being struck by the inspired soul. Thus the confession...

Speech signifies thanksgiving, for the requests have come to pass. He desired to know the reason for being driven away and for walking in darkness; he desired that the light and the truth be sent to him, since they led him; he desired to enter the altar of God and to experience the tabernacles of God and the holy mountain. Since, therefore, of these good requests it has come to pass through experience by God having given them to him, and not by himself having found them, because of this he may gratefully confess to him, striking the senses, which are nerves or lyres, and various thoughts or members; for when each of the members is tuned toward virtue, it is a stretched nerve, so that it may be struck musically by the striker of truth.

“Why are you dejected, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I shall confess to him” (Ps 42:5). He asked if something belonged to him, and while he was still speaking of it, he sighed; moreover, before he receives, he has thus faithfully determined as if he had already received. Therefore he rouses his soul and says: “Why are you dejected, my soul?” Since, therefore, I have pre-decided to confess to him, hope in Him; accept that the things of thanksgiving shall belong to you. And the confession here signifies thanksgiving.

“God is the salvation of my face” (Ps 118:5). “You are the salvation of my true face” (Ps 118:14). The light is the salvation of your inner man, concerning which it is said: “The wisdom of a man makes his face shine” (Prov 15:13). And again the saint says to have “the eyes of the heart” (Eph 1:18) enlightened, and “with an unveiled face to reflect the glory of the Lord” (2 Cor 3:18). When the face is reflected by the appropriate and divine glory and is enlightened by wisdom, God is my salvation. Others, having been rescued from sickness, said: “My salvation is the physician”; and another, having been rescued from storm and sea, let him say: “My salvation is the pilot.

To the end: A psalm to the sons of Korah for understanding (Ps 147:1). Much has been said about the end, that the last thing is desirable, for the sake of which all other things come to be, but it is not for the sake of anything else... to have. He who knows the end knows also the poetic qualities of the end before...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
